quest.title: Yanxiao's Dilemma
quest.description: Something is bothering Smiley Yanxiao, the chef of Wangshu Inn...

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Hmph, he's got some nerve scrounging off me all this time...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you doing?

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: I'm cooking for someone who doesn't deserve it, that's what!

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Unbelievable! He whiles away his time doing whatever he pleases and doesn't even offer to help at the inn.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: He spends most of his day fishing, but I've never seen him catch more than a couple of tiddlers.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: If it wasn't for me, he'd starve to death!

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Ugh, what's the use in complaining. He can't hear me — and even if he could, he'd act like he hadn't.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: If you've got nothing better to do, you can go grab me a couple of extra ingredients. I'm running low here.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Don't need much. Just one <color=#00E1FFFF>Jueyun Chili</color> and one <color=#00E1FFFF>Lotus Head</color> will do it.

response.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
response.text: Bring them back here as soon as you find them. I want to get this done and dusted.

choices.text: But there's plenty of ingredients here...

response.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
response.text: My boss paid good money for those. Do you think this freeloader's gonna pay my boss back? I think not.

response.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
response.text: Everything I cook for him comes out of my own pocket... Hmph, he owes me big time!

response.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
response.text: Just go fetch the vegetables, will you? It's not a huge ask, and it won't take you long.

talks.objective: Help Smiley Yanxiao find Jueyun Chili and Lotus Head

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Where are my vegetables?

response.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
response.text: ...Why on earth not!? Go get them! Otherwise, that waste of space is going to turn into a hungry waste of space.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Wait here. When the food's ready, I'll get you to take it over to him.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Don't look so hard done by! I'm not making you do this for free. You'll get what you deserve, don't you worry.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Alright. It's ready. Take this over to Mr. Doesn't-Know-How-Lucky-He-Is...

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: His name is <color=#00E1FFFF>Jiangxue</color>. He'll be fishing down by the water, you can't miss him.

talks.objective: Bring the dish Smiley Yanxiao made to Jiangxue

dialogues.speaker: Jiangxue
dialogues.text: Hello? Is it me you're looking for?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: This is from Smiley Yanxiao.

dialogues.speaker: Jiangxue
dialogues.text: Aha! I was wondering where that delicious smell was coming from. He's a really talented chef, you know.

dialogues.speaker: Jiangxue
dialogues.text: Thanks for bringing this. And make sure you thank him profusely for me when you get back.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Did you deliver the food?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yes, and he said to make sure I—

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Thank me profusely? Please. Spare me that charade.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: The number of times I've heard those words these last few years... drives me mad.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Thanking me profusely seems to be his only other pastime aside from fishing. Tell you what, how about pack all that in, stop wasting time, and come earn your keep at the inn?

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: Ah, there's no use me venting at you. Here's your reward — you've earned it, unlike some people. Now you can get back to living your life.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: And don't delay! A happy cheapskate is preferable to a hungry cheapskate, trust me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why do you cook for him?

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: If you must know, it's because he's got no one else. I'm the only person he knows in the whole of Liyue. And this is the only place he dares to try and scrounge from.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: ...What's the reason? Why does it matter? Fine... It's because I'm willing to cook for him. Happy now?

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: If I wasn't willing to cook for him, he'd probably go and do something stupid down at Dihua Marsh again. And we can't be having that.

dialogues.speaker: Smiley Yanxiao
dialogues.text: What are you still hanging round here for? Quit dawdling and get going!

dialogues.speaker: Jiangxue
dialogues.text: You're still here? ...It's probably best that you get back; when you keep him waiting he tends to throw one of his temper tantrums.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why does he cook for you?

dialogues.speaker: Jiangxue
dialogues.text: We're... friends. We've known each other a very long time.

dialogues.speaker: Jiangxue
dialogues.text: I, uh... I went to Dihua Marsh once to do... a bad thing. But something I had to do.

dialogues.speaker: Jiangxue
dialogues.text: This is the only place in the whole of Liyue where they let me stay, and the chef here makes sure I'm fed.

dialogues.speaker: Jiangxue
dialogues.text: I won't elaborate any further — it's a long story, and you probably have better things to do with your time.

dialogues.speaker: Jiangxue
dialogues.text: I'd better let you go — that chef is not the patient type.
